scripts.build:ui: bun run --bun tsc --noEmit && bun run --bun vite build
scripts.format: bun run --bun prettier --write src tests scripts/*.ts vite.config.ts tsconfig.json index.html package.json
scripts.format:check: bun run --bun prettier --check src tests scripts/*.ts vite.config.ts tsconfig.json index.html package.json
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run --bun tsc --noEmit && bun test
